output.subject: Your mobile check deposit
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for speaking with us about the trouble you've had depositing a check through our mobile app. You told us that you tried to deposit a check for $812, and that it was rejected four times for image quality. You mentioned that even after our representative went through some tips with you on the call, the deposit was still rejected.

We understand how frustrating it is when something that should be quick keeps failing, especially when you're trying to get money into your account. We're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

You've told us you'd like to be able to complete this deposit using the mobile app. We've passed the details of your call to our Digital Banking team, who will review what happened. During your call, our representative also mentioned that you can deposit the check at a branch or ATM if you'd prefer.

We will respond within 10 business days. If anything changes in the meantime, or you have more details to share, please let us know.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Check the status of the digital support ticket opened after the call and whether a cause for the image-quality rejections was found.
Confirm whether the customer has since deposited the $812 check at a branch or ATM, and adjust the reply if so.
Decide whether to include specific guidance or next steps for retrying the mobile deposit.
Check whether funds availability or any time-sensitive payment depends on this deposit.
